report.summary: All cited factual claims are supported by the cited pages after lakh-to-crore conversions and arithmetic implications were checked. The only recurring citation issue is that three sentences citing p112 include the name '20 Microns Limited', which p112 does not contain (the name appears on p113/p155); those are partial rather than unsupported. No unsupported, wrong-source, or untagged specific company claims requiring citation were identified.
